start: Your profile, a mobile number saved

must_not: The bar before the remove saved

steps.action: Do step 1 of "Undo bar after a delete" on the phone with the watch connected; look at both. Then do it from the watch.
user_sees: Phone and watch show the same saved data within a few seconds
must_not: Two different values on phone and watch, a double saved data made by both, or the watch stuck on the old state

note: Undoing a deleted set must bring it back on the watch too

start: Your profile, a mobile number saved; set-up: longest name or text

steps.action: Use the longest allowed name or text for saved data (a 60-letter name, a 500-letter note), then do "Undo bar after a delete".
user_sees: The text wraps or is cut with dots; every button can still be reached
must_not: Text over other text, a button pushed off the screen, or the saved data saved with its text cut without a word to the user
The bar before the remove saved
Text over other text, a button pushed off the screen, or the saved data saved with its text cut without a word to the user

note: A long item name in the bar must wrap with 'Undo' reachable

start: Your profile, a mobile number saved

must_not: The bar before the remove saved

steps.action: Close the app (swipe it away) at step 1 of "Undo bar after a delete", then open it again.
user_sees: Either nothing was saved, or the saved data is whole; the app says which
must_not: A half-saved saved data, a double saved data after trying again, or a stuck screen on reopening

note: If the app closes while the bar shows, the time-out is never called; each screen decides whether the delete holds

start: Your profile, a mobile number saved

must_not: The bar before the remove saved

steps.action: Tap the main button of step 1 of "Undo bar after a delete" twice, fast.
user_sees: One result; the button shows it is busy
must_not: Two rows of saved data, two charges, two messages sent, or two screens opened

note: If the app closes while the bar shows, the time-out is never called; each screen decides whether the delete holds

start: Your profile, a mobile number saved

must_not: The bar before the remove saved

steps.action: Lock the phone at step 1 of "Undo bar after a delete", wait two minutes, unlock.
user_sees: The same screen with the same typed values
must_not: A lost draft of saved data, a timer or count that stopped, or a sign-out with no reason given

note: If the app closes while the bar shows, the time-out is never called; each screen decides whether the delete holds

start: Your profile, a mobile number saved; set-up: phone 360 px wide

steps.action: Do "Undo bar after a delete" on a phone screen 360 px wide.
user_sees: Every word, figure and button of the journey in full
must_not: Cut-off text, a button off the screen, sideways scrolling, or two things on top of each other
